ISOs come straight from each project\'s official servers and mirrors. Anvil checks the distro\'s signature on the checksum list and the SHA-256 of the ISO, and never writes a file that fails either check.
Copies a folder to \Drivers on the USB drive, for example your laptop\'s Intel RST storage driver.
Choose the drivers folder, or turn this option off.
If Setup says “No drivers were found”

Laptops with Intel RST/VMD storage (many 11th gen Intel and newer) hide the disk from Windows Setup. Either:\n• In the BIOS, set SATA mode to AHCI or disable VMD, or\n• In Setup, tap Load driver → Browse and open \Drivers on this USB drive.

Laptops with Intel RST/VMD storage (many 11th gen Intel and newer) hide the disk from Windows Setup. Either:\n• In the BIOS, set SATA mode to AHCI or disable VMD, or\n• Write the drive again with “Add drivers folder” on, pick your laptop\'s Intel RST driver, then in Setup tap Load driver → Browse → \Drivers.
Uses small 16 KiB USB transfers. Slower, but helps with phones, OTG hubs and USB drives that disconnect or fail mid-write.
Compatibility mode is on: writing is slower but more reliable.
